posts.name: anand mahindra
posts.text:
On Diwali, how could the imagination of a #SundayWanderer travel anywhere but to Ayodhya?

The magnificent spectacle of countless diyas illuminating the city evokes the timeless story of Lord Ram’s return after 14 years of exile, when the people of Ayodhya lit up their city to welcome him home.

I’ve never been to Ayodhya. But one day, I hope to be there on Diwali, to join in that joyous, symbolic welcome home to Lord Ram.

Until then, my imagination will have to make the journey for me…

From my family to yours, wishing you a Diwali filled with light, love, joy and togetherness. 

Happy Diwali! 🪔
posts.note: Anand Mahindra on Ayodhya's diyas and coming home
